title: VooPoo Argus E40 Replacement pods 2ml - 2 Pods
description: The Voopoo Argus E40 Refillable Pods are the perfect companion for your Voopoo Argus E40 Pod Kit, providing a seamless and satisfying MTL (Mouth To Lung), RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung), or DTL (Direct-To-Lung) vaping experience. The side-fill design of the Argus E40 pods ensures that refilling is quick, intuitive, and mess-free. Simply open the side port and fill the pod with your preferred e-liquid. The built-in mesh coil technology heats the e-liquid evenly, delivering rich and authentic flavours with every puff. When the coil reaches the end of its lifespan, replacing the entire pod is a breeze, ensuring that you can continue to enjoy a consistent and flavourful vaping experience. These refillable pods are designed specifically for the Voopoo Argus E40 Pod Kit, ensuring a perfect fit and optimal performance. The 0.3ohm pod is ideal for those who prefer a DTL vaping experience with High-VG E-Liquids, providing rich flavour and dense vapour. The 0.45ohm pod offers a balanced RDL experience, while the 0.6ohm pod is perfect for a smooth MTL draw with 50/50 E-Liquids. These pods allow you to fine-tune your vaping setup to match your desired style and nicotine strength, providing a consistent and satisfying vape every time. Voopoo Argus E40 0.3ohm pods DTL - We Recommend paring with High VG E-Liquids. Voopoo Argus E40 0.45ohm pods RDTL - We Recommend paring with 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids. Voopoo Argus E40 0.6ohm Pods MTL - We Recommend paring with 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
